title: TensorCommitments: A Lightweight Verifiable Inference for Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.12630v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Most large language models (LLMs) run on external clouds: users send a prompt, pay for inference, and must trust that the remote GPU executes the LLM without any adversarial tampering. We critically ask how to achieve verifiable LLM inference, where a prover (the service) must convince a verifier (the client) that an inference was run correctly without rerunning the LLM. Existing cryptographic works are too slow at the LLM scale, while non-cryptographic ones require a strong verifier GPU. We propose TensorCommitments (TCs), a tensor-native proof-of-inference scheme. TC binds the LLM inference to a commitment, an irreversible tag that breaks under tampering, organized in our multivariate Terkle Trees. For LLaMA2, TC adds only 0.97% prover and 0.12% verifier time over inference while improving robustness to tailored LLM attacks by up to 48% over the best prior work requiring a verifier GPU.

translated_title: 张量承诺：一种面向语言模型的轻量级可验证推理方案
translated_abstract: 大多数大型语言模型（LLM）运行在外部云上：用户发送提示词、为推理付费，并且必须信任远程GPU在没有任何对抗性篡改的情况下执行大语言模型。我们批判性地探讨如何实现可验证的大语言模型推理，即证明者（服务方）必须在不重新运行大语言模型的情况下，使验证者（客户端）确信推理被正确执行。现有的密码学方法在大语言模型规模下速度太慢，而非密码学方法则需要强大的验证者GPU。我们提出了张量承诺（TCs），一种张量原生的推理证明方案。TC将大语言模型推理与一个承诺绑定——这是一种在篡改下会失效的不可逆标签——并通过我们提出的多变量Terkle树进行组织。对于LLaMA2，TC在推理基础上仅增加0.97%的证明者时间和0.12%的验证者时间，同时相比需要验证者GPU的最佳先前工作，将针对定制化大语言模型攻击的鲁棒性提升了高达48%。
tldr: 提出张量承诺（TC）这一张量原生的推理证明方案，通过多变量Terkle树将大语言模型推理与篡改即失效的不可逆承诺绑定，仅需约1%的额外时间开销即可实现可验证推理，并将对定制化LLM攻击的鲁棒性提升高达48%。
en_tdlr: TensorCommitments (TCs) is a tensor-native proof-of-inference scheme that binds LLM inference to irreversible tamper-evident commitments via multivariate Terkle Trees, achieving verifiable inference with only ~1% overhead while improving robustness to tailored LLM attacks by up to 48%.
